description: Buddy Phase 5 — Critical Risk Controls & Operational Resilience. Live trading exposed position sizing breach (135% risk on single trade), weak agent consensus (1/3) still executing, and degraded ensemble without TF. Phase 5 hardens the system so it cannot self-harm even when models are missing. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP BRAINSTORMING/RESEARCHING AND IMPROVING. DONT ASK FOR EVERY COMMAND, JUST DO. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Fix position sizing pre-execution risk budget check
userStories.description: As a risk management system, I must calculate projected portfolio risk BEFORE sending any order to OANDA, not after. The current system filled an 11.36 lot trade that consumed 135% of NAV risk budget.
acceptanceCriteria: execution.py checks projected_risk = (existing_risk + new_trade_risk) BEFORE placing order
If projected_risk > max_portfolio_risk (15%), reduce lot size to fit within budget
If minimum viable lot (0.01) still exceeds budget, skip trade entirely with logged reason
Position sizing uses actual NAV from OANDA account, not cached value
Add unit test verifying: 11.36 lots on $102K NAV at ATR SL correctly rejected or downsized
Log every risk-adjusted sizing decision to observations.jsonl
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: _check_projected_portfolio_risk() added to execution.py. Projects new trade risk before order. Downsizes or skips if over 15% NAV budget.

userStories.title: Agent consensus minimum gate (block trades with <3/12 agents)
userStories.description: As a trading system, executing trades with only 1/3 agent consensus is reckless. Add a hard minimum agent consensus gate.
acceptanceCriteria: New gate in engine.py: min_agent_consensus (default 0.25 = 3/12 agents)
Trades with agent_votes/agent_total < min_agent_consensus are blocked
Gate logged in why_no_trade with clear reason: 'agent consensus too low (1/12 < 3/12)'
Configurable per profile (smart=0.25, conservative=0.33, aggressive=0.17)
Works alongside existing weighted_vote_score check
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: min_agent_consensus_ratio added to ScannerConfig (default 0.25). Hard gate in _apply_agent_consensus() blocks trades below threshold.

userStories.title: Graceful degraded-model ensemble with confidence penalty
userStories.description: As a self-aware system, when TF/XGBoost models are unavailable, the ensemble should still function but apply a confidence penalty reflecting reduced prediction quality.
acceptanceCriteria: engine.py detects which models are loaded at startup (TF, XGB, Ridge, RF, LightGBM)
If less than 3 model types available, apply degraded_ensemble_penalty to confidence
Penalty formula: confidence *= (available_models / expected_models) e.g. 2/5 = 0.4x
Log degraded state to observations.jsonl at startup with list of missing models
state.json tracks ensemble_health: {available: ['ridge','rf'], missing: ['tf','xgb','lgbm']}
Degraded ensemble still trades but with appropriately lowered confidence
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: _assess_ensemble_health() checks 5 model slots (tcn, histgb, regime_model, xgb, ridge). Penalty applied in _run_inference(). Logged to observations.jsonl.

userStories.title: Harden all import chains with lazy loading audit
userStories.description: As an operational system, the CLI must boot without tensorflow, xgboost, lightgbm, or catboost installed. All heavy ML imports must be lazy.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit all __init__.py files in src/ for eager imports of tensorflow, xgboost, lightgbm, catboost
Convert any remaining eager imports to lazy (using __getattr__ pattern)
python main.py --help succeeds without tensorflow installed
python main.py scan --profile smart succeeds without tensorflow
Add smoke test: scripts/test_no_tf_boot.py that mocks tensorflow as missing and verifies CLI boot
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: All __init__.py files clean. scripts/test_no_tf_boot.py blocks TF/XGB/LightGBM/CatBoost and verifies 5 import chains pass.

userStories.title: Validator regression test and self-healing
userStories.description: As a deployment system, the validator should test itself and auto-fix data issues it can safely repair (like missing agent weights or journal fields).
acceptanceCriteria: validate_deployment.py --self-test runs validator against known-good and known-bad fixtures
Validator correctly maps pip package names to Python import names (sklearn, yaml, dotenv)
Validator understands regime-aware agent_weights.json format (not just flat dict)
Optional --auto-fix flag: auto-populates missing agent weights from _BASE_WEIGHTS baseline
Optional --auto-fix flag: computes missing sl_pips/tp_pips from price data in journal
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: --self-test runs 5 fixture tests (known-good, missing agents, import map, auto-fix weights, auto-fix journal). --auto-fix safely repairs agent weights and journal fields.

userStories.title: Live performance metrics and system health summary
userStories.description: As an operator, I need a quick summary of system health, model status, and trading performance available from the CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: python main.py status prints: NAV, open trades, win rate, model health, agent weights status
Shows ensemble status (which models loaded, which missing)
Shows last 5 trades with P/L and R:R
Shows active risk scaler state (normal/reduced/floor)
Shows blocked pairs and why
Output uses rich formatting (tables/panels)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: scripts/buddy_status.py with ANSI-formatted panels. Shows live OANDA NAV, open trades, recent trades, ensemble health, agent weights, risk scaler, blocked pairs. Wired into main.py dispatch.
